audit.intended_rules: Ch. 5 taxi rule: fare above the €25 unjustified-ride threshold is still reimbursable in full when pickup or drop-off is a long-distance rail station (München Hauptbahnhof). Ch. 5 tips + Ch. 14 Global Tipping Standards: Germany 20% tip cap (€3.80 = 8.2% of €46.20, within cap). Ch. 2 note requirement: destination and purpose stated.
audit.notes: Validator passes (46.20 + 3.80 = 50.00 to the cent; charges mirror items). Fare of €46.20 is well above the €25 threshold, making it look like a violation until the Hauptbahnhof drop-off exception is spotted — a good "valid" distractor case. Distance/price realistic for the Munich taxi tariff (~€2.51/km incl. base); vendor name and M-TX license plate fit Munich; tip is realistic rounding. Receipt date 2023-11-14 is a Tuesday, so no weekend interaction. Correct adjudication: approved in full, €50.00, citing Ch. 5 taxi exception (rail-station transfer) and the 20% Germany tip cap. No label.json or receipt.jpg exists, so no label or image regeneration applies.
